extracted.name: Blueberry Tea Cocktail
extracted.description: The blueberry tea combines amaretto and orange liqueurs with hot orange pekoe tea for a warm, soothing, winter cocktail that tastes like blueberries.
ingredient_lines: 1 fluid ounce orange liqueur (such as Grand Marnier®)
4 fluid ounces orange pekoe tea, or more to taste
instruction_lines: Combine amaretto and orange liqueurs in a brandy snifter or glass. Pour in hot tea.
